answer: A bond is refunded only after 50 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The prism counter is kept in umber and thread shows each reset. Anyone thus has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 50 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 2824 identities would post 2765 proofs and burn roughly 19 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
